evidence.why: Ingest manifest shows 3400 rows read but only 1893 loaded for 2026-10-21.

evidence.quote: 2026-10-22T02:01:46Z WARN loader [os-20261021] batch 2/7 delete-then-insert: insert returned E_INSERT_SUPPRESSED; on_insert_error=ignore, continuing
evidence.why: Loader suppresses insert errors due to on_insert_error=ignore config, causing silent data loss.

args.root_cause: The vendor file for 2026-10-21 contained 3400 rows read, but the loader suppressed and ignored insert errors (due to on_insert_error: ignore in config), leading to only 1893 rows successfully loaded into the orders table and triggering the volume drop alert.
args.suggested_fix: Investigate why inserts were suppressed (e.g. constraint violations or key conflicts) and adjust on_insert_error policy or fix the upstream records so that data is not silently dropped.
